sources.scope: Official 2026–27 degree identity, curriculum and target-linked interests. Replaces the previous programme URL, which returned HTTP 404.
2026–27 study guide and programme-specific implementation regulations, including credit distribution, entry conditions and elective inventory.
Official degree overview and explanation of free space and graduation.

curriculum: The Dutch-taught, part-time Psychology BSc has 60 EC of foundation courses and 60 EC of later compulsory courses, 25 EC of restricted minor-course choices, 20 EC of free electives and a 15 EC thesis. The implementation regulations distinguish six minor offerings, five oriented toward master variants. A student can choose a complete 15 EC minor with 10 EC of other minor courses. The comparison preserves choice instead of fixing a course from each of five areas. Current replacements include the experimental and cross-sectional practicums and Work and Health Psychology; Psychological Diagnostics is new in the compulsory inventory. Historical replacements and duplicate exclusions remain internal.
progression: The literature study requires 25 foundation EC including the introductory research practicum. The experimental practicum builds on introductory research; the cross-sectional practicum requires introductory research, introduction to science and literature study. The longitudinal practicum follows cross-sectional work. Psychological interviewing requires the foundation, conversation skills and 50 post-foundation EC. Psychological diagnostics requires psychometrics. The thesis requires 120 completed EC, including all research practicums and the literature study. The timetable places the required research and literature work before the thesis and shows multiple thesis starts. Fixed and variable pacing apply to the part-time degree.
